title: GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2

description: We weighed the Givi GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 at 1471 grams. Built with a Thermoplastic shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets ECE 22.06 safety standards.

product_details.description: Sporty road helmet with spoiler and double-D ring closure.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 is a full-face track helmet designed for high-speed riding; specific fit notes require manufacturer sizing chart.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 96.5 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in Givi's Full Face lineup, the GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
yoast_title: Givi GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 Review: 1471g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the Givi GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2. Verified 1471g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, ECE 22.06 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Global GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in Givi's Full Face lineup, the GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Givi GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 represents Global Premium head protection design, incorporates aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Thermoplastic shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 96.5 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a Thermoplastic Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the GIVI 50.8 Racer Track TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
